We have to divide a negative number ${\color{red}(-81)}$ by another negative number ${\color{red}(-9)}.$ So the result will be positive:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14147219/assets/bcbaff723e9bce7d0cd513fb879cbc0a9758c2c5d9d584f4c55aab9df25e46d3.svg)

Now, to compute the number that goes in the box, we divide $81$ by $9$ without any signs: $81 \div 9 = 9.$ Therefore,  we get

$$
{\color{red}(-81)} \div {\color{red}(-9)} = {\color{blue}9}.
$$
